meta.title: Skip vendor review with manual entry of global charges per lot

plan.title: Skip Vendor Review with Manual Lot Charges

steps.note: Open the existing event with a pending vendor Lot Adjustment.

args.goal: On the buyer's Lot RFQ screen, locate the vendor with a pending Lot Adjustment, click Skip Vendor Review under the vendor's name, choose Manual entry, enter global charge values for every lot, enter a reason, click Confirm & Skip Review, and stop when the confirmation tooltip and each lot show the manually entered charge values.

steps.note: Perform and visually verify the complete manual skip-review workflow, including the confirmation and per-lot charges.
Confirm the completed workflow did not leave an application error.
